sources.entry: django-redis - Full-featured Redis cache backend for Django.

summary.one_liner: django-redis is a BSD-licensed, full-featured Redis cache and session backend for Django.
summary.what_it_does: It plugs Redis into Django's cache framework using redis-py URL connection strings over TCP, SSL (rediss://), or Unix sockets. It can also be used as the session store through Django's cache session engine. Beyond the standard cache API, it adds TTL inspection (ttl, pttl), expire/persist/expire_at/pexpire methods, distributed locks via cache.lock(), and key scanning and deletion by glob pattern (keys, iter_keys, delete_pattern). It offers pluggable clients (default with primary/replica support, sharding, thundering-herd handling, Sentinel), pluggable serializers (pickle, JSON, MsgPack), optional compression (zlib, lzma, lz4, zstd, gzip), and connection pool customization. It can also be configured to ignore Redis connection errors, memcached-style.
use_cases: Using Redis as Django's cache backend
Setting per-key expirations and TTL checks in Django
Deleting groups of cache keys by pattern
Connecting Django to Redis Sentinel or replicas
how_to_run: Set CACHES['default']['BACKEND'] = 'django_redis.cache.RedisCache' and LOCATION = 'redis://127.0.0.1:6379/1' in Django settings
Optionally set SESSION_ENGINE = 'django.contrib.sessions.backends.cache' to store sessions in Redis
Optionally pip install hiredis for a faster parser
notable: Accepts native redis-py URL connection strings, including unix:// socket paths and ACL username/password
Pluggable clients: default with replication, ShardClient, HerdClient, SentinelClient
Infinite timeouts (timeout=None) and Redis-backed ttl/pttl/persist/expire APIs
Memcached-style IGNORE_EXCEPTIONS mode with optional logging
Supports Sentinel connection factory with primary/replica pools
caveats: Replication setup is stated to be not heavily tested in production
Shard client is described as experimental
Not all pluggable clients support get_redis_connection raw access
